newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia bourse posts strong rise.
newsitem.headline: Estonia bourse posts strong rise.

text.p: Estonian shares posted strong gains on Friday with Tallinn Pharmaceutical leading the way, dealers said.
The Tallinn stock exchange index rose 3.83 percent to close at 192.54 on turnover of 58.34 million kroons.

"There are always two waves with price gains in Estonia. Large investors lead the way on the first day and on the second day small investor buying supports the price and pushes up the market," said one trader.
Tallinn Pharmaceutical ended a sluggish period and was most traded on 14.2 million kroons to close up 2.75 at 116 kroons.
Tallinn Pharma was targeted by local investors and dealers said local players were buying Tallinn Pharma as they thought it was a cheap stock.
Savings Bank was well traded with 13.3 million kroons changing hands to close up 2.44 kroons at 88.25.
Hansapank closed down three kroons at 182 kroons after turning over 9.5 million kroons of shares.
"As foreign investors started selling local investors were buying and supported prices," said one broker, speaking of the market as a whole.
Union Bank lost 1.30 kroons to close at 42.65 kroons with a volume of 9.3 million kroons.
Forekspank also eased to close 0.75 kroons down at 143.25 kroons a share with 7.6 million kroons of shares traded.
The over-the-counter volume was at 13.3 million kroons. Rakvere meat plant stayed at yesterday's fix to close at 14.80 kroons after turning over 3.9 million kroons.
Confectionery continued to climb to reach 1,470 kroons up 170 kroons with 0.9 million kroons traded.
